paragraphs.title: Isaac asks Esau for game and a blessing

easy.question: Who called Esau at the beginning of the passage?
answers: Isaac
Jacob
Abraham
easy.explanation: The verse says, “He called Esau his eldest son”; Isaac called Esau.

easy.question: What did Isaac ask Esau to take with him?
answers: Bread and water
His weapons and bow
Clothes and gifts
easy.explanation: Isaac told Esau to take his weapons and bow and go into the field.

easy.question: Why did Isaac ask Esau to prepare savory food?
answers: To invite guests
To take it into the field
So he could eat and bless Esau before he died
easy.explanation: Isaac wanted to eat the food and then bless Esau before his death.

medium.question: Why did Isaac ask Esau to hunt and prepare savory food before the blessing?
answers: He wanted to eat food he loved before blessing him
He wanted to teach him to hunt
He wanted Esau to take the food into the field
medium.explanation: Isaac asked Esau to hunt, prepare food as he loved it, and bring it to him so he could eat and bless him.

medium.question: In the phrase “go out to the field, and take me some venison,” what does “take me” mean?
answers: Save food for me
Bring me an animal that you have hunted
Cook vegetables for me
medium.explanation: Isaac tells Esau to hunt game and bring it to him.

medium.question: What order of events is described in these verses?
answers: Esau brings food, goes hunting, and then Isaac calls him
Isaac blesses Esau, and then Esau prepares food
Isaac calls Esau, Esau goes hunting, prepares food, and brings it
medium.explanation: Isaac first calls Esau and gives him instructions; Esau is then to hunt and prepare food.

challenge.question: What can be inferred from “make me savoury meat, such as I love” and “that my soul may bless thee”?
answers: Isaac connects eating the food he loves with blessing Esau
Isaac wants Esau to bless him
Isaac wants Esau to prepare food for the whole family
challenge.explanation: Isaac asks for food he loves and intends to bless Esau after eating it.

challenge.question: Why does the text identify Esau as Isaac’s “eldest son”?
answers: To say Esau was his only son
To identify Esau and distinguish him from Isaac’s other son
To say Esau was as old as Isaac
challenge.explanation: The description identifies Esau as the older or firstborn son and distinguishes him from Jacob.

challenge.question: What can be understood from Isaac saying, “I know not the day of my death,” and asking to bless him “before I die”?
answers: Isaac knows exactly when he will die
Isaac does not intend to bless Esau
Isaac does not know when he will die and therefore wants to bless Esau beforehand
challenge.explanation: Isaac does not know when he will die, so he wants to give the blessing before then.

questions.question: What can be inferred from “make me savoury meat, such as I love” and “that my soul may bless thee”?
answers: Isaac connects eating the food he loves with blessing Esau
Isaac wants Esau to bless him
Isaac wants Esau to prepare food for the whole family
questions.explanation: Isaac asks for food he loves and intends to bless Esau after eating it.

questions.question: Why does the text identify Esau as Isaac’s “eldest son”?
answers: To say Esau was his only son
To identify Esau and distinguish him from Isaac’s other son
To say Esau was as old as Isaac
questions.explanation: The description identifies Esau as the older or firstborn son and distinguishes him from Jacob.

questions.question: What can be understood from Isaac saying, “I know not the day of my death,” and asking to bless him “before I die”?
answers: Isaac knows exactly when he will die
Isaac does not intend to bless Esau
Isaac does not know when he will die and therefore wants to bless Esau beforehand
questions.explanation: Isaac does not know when he will die, so he wants to give the blessing before then.

paragraphs.title: Rebekah hears and makes a plan with Jacob

easy.question: Who heard Isaac speaking to Esau?
answers: Rebekah
Leah
Rachel
easy.explanation: Verse 5 says, “And Rebekah heard.”

easy.question: Where did Esau go?
answers: To the flock
Into the field
Into the house
easy.explanation: Esau went into the field to hunt game.

easy.question: What did Rebekah ask Jacob to take from the flock?
answers: One lamb
Two rams
Two good young goats
easy.explanation: Rebekah told Jacob to fetch two good kids from the goats.

medium.question: Why did Rebekah ask Jacob to prepare food for his father?
answers: So Isaac would bless Jacob
So Esau would return home
So Jacob could go hunting
medium.explanation: Rebekah wanted Jacob to bring the food to Isaac and receive the blessing.

medium.question: In “make me savoury meat,” what does “savoury meat” mean?
answers: Eating utensils
Tasty food
Special clothing
medium.explanation: The phrase refers to delicious food prepared for eating.

medium.question: For whom was the food Jacob prepared intended?
answers: Esau
Rebekah
Isaac
medium.explanation: Rebekah asked Jacob to prepare it for his father Isaac.

challenge.question: How is Esau’s going hunting connected to Rebekah’s plan?
answers: Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah used young goats to prepare the food
Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah sent Jacob to find him
Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah asked Jacob to go with him
challenge.explanation: While Esau was searching for game, Rebekah prepared a substitute using goats from the flock.

challenge.question: What does “that he may bless thee” mean in this passage?
answers: Because Jacob had already blessed Isaac
So Isaac would bless Jacob
So Esau would bless Jacob
challenge.explanation: Jacob was to bring the food so that his father would bless him.

challenge.question: Which detail shows that Rebekah planned to replace Esau’s hunted food with something else?
answers: Jacob was sent into the field to hunt
Isaac asked Rebekah to prepare the food
Jacob took young goats from the flock to prepare as food
challenge.explanation: Instead of Esau bringing game, Jacob was to use young goats from the flock.

questions.question: How is Esau’s going hunting connected to Rebekah’s plan?
answers: Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah used young goats to prepare the food
Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah sent Jacob to find him
Because Esau went hunting, Rebekah asked Jacob to go with him
questions.explanation: While Esau was searching for game, Rebekah prepared a substitute using goats from the flock.

questions.question: What does “that he may bless thee” mean in this passage?
answers: Because Jacob had already blessed Isaac
So Isaac would bless Jacob
So Esau would bless Jacob
questions.explanation: Jacob was to bring the food so that his father would bless him.

questions.question: Which detail shows that Rebekah planned to replace Esau’s hunted food with something else?
answers: Jacob was sent into the field to hunt
Isaac asked Rebekah to prepare the food
Jacob took young goats from the flock to prepare as food
questions.explanation: Instead of Esau bringing game, Jacob was to use young goats from the flock.

easy.question: Who was hairy, according to Jacob?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Isaac
easy.explanation: Jacob said that his brother Esau was a hairy man.

easy.question: What did Jacob fear would happen if his father touched him?
answers: His father would think he was deceiving him
His father would send him hunting
His father would give him new clothes
easy.explanation: Jacob feared Isaac would see him as a deceiver and not believe him.

easy.question: What did Rebekah put on Jacob’s hands and neck?
answers: Esau’s clothes
The skins of the young goats
Isaac’s clothes
easy.explanation: Rebekah put goat skins on Jacob’s hands and the smooth part of his neck.

medium.question: Why did Rebekah dress Jacob in Esau’s clothes?
answers: So Isaac would think he was Esau
So Jacob could go hunting
So Esau would recognize him
medium.explanation: Esau’s clothes and their smell helped Jacob appear to Isaac to be Esau.

medium.question: In “I shall seem to him as a deceiver,” what does “deceiver” mean?
answers: Someone who honors his father
Someone who cheats or misleads
Someone who asks for food
medium.explanation: Jacob feared Isaac would think he was trying to deceive him.

medium.question: What did Rebekah do after Jacob brought what she had requested?
answers: She sent him to Esau
She prepared the food and disguised him
She told Isaac the plan
medium.explanation: She prepared savory food, took Esau’s clothes, and put goat skins on Jacob.

challenge.question: Which detail shows that Rebekah planned the deception in several stages?
answers: She only asked Jacob to bring food
She prepared food and also changed his appearance and smell
She asked Esau to speak with Isaac
challenge.explanation: She prepared food, dressed Jacob in Esau’s clothes, and put skins on him.

challenge.question: Why was Jacob especially worried about Isaac touching him rather than only seeing him?
answers: Isaac would check by touch whether he was as hairy as Esau
Isaac could not hear
Jacob did not know how to speak
challenge.explanation: Jacob feared that touch would reveal that he was smooth rather than hairy like Esau.

challenge.question: What can be inferred from Rebekah placing the food and bread into Jacob’s hands?
answers: She wanted Jacob to present them to Isaac himself
She wanted Jacob to eat them alone
She wanted Esau to take them hunting
challenge.explanation: Jacob was to bring the food to Isaac as part of his disguise.

questions.question: Which detail shows that Rebekah planned the deception in several stages?
answers: She only asked Jacob to bring food
She prepared food and also changed his appearance and smell
She asked Esau to speak with Isaac
questions.explanation: She prepared food, dressed Jacob in Esau’s clothes, and put skins on him.

questions.question: Why was Jacob especially worried about Isaac touching him rather than only seeing him?
answers: Isaac would check by touch whether he was as hairy as Esau
Isaac could not hear
Jacob did not know how to speak
questions.explanation: Jacob feared that touch would reveal that he was smooth rather than hairy like Esau.

questions.question: What can be inferred from Rebekah placing the food and bread into Jacob’s hands?
answers: She wanted Jacob to present them to Isaac himself
She wanted Jacob to eat them alone
She wanted Esau to take them hunting
questions.explanation: Jacob was to bring the food to Isaac as part of his disguise.

paragraphs.title: Jacob stands before Isaac and is tested

easy.question: Who entered Isaac’s presence at the beginning of the passage?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Abraham
easy.explanation: Jacob came to his father Isaac while pretending to be Esau.

easy.question: What did Jacob ask Isaac to do after eating?
answers: Send him hunting
Bless him
Call Esau
easy.explanation: Jacob said he had prepared the food so that Isaac would bless him.

easy.question: What did Isaac recognize as Jacob’s?
answers: His voice
His hands
His clothes
easy.explanation: Isaac said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice.”

medium.question: Why did Isaac ask to feel Jacob?
answers: To check whether his hands were hairy like Esau’s
To teach him to hunt
To find out whether he was hungry
medium.explanation: Isaac wanted to check whether the son’s hands resembled Esau’s hairy hands.

medium.question: In “How is it that thou hast found it so quickly,” what does “quickly” mean?
answers: After a long delay
In a short time
After getting lost
medium.explanation: Isaac wondered how Jacob had found game so soon.

medium.question: How did Isaac conclude that Jacob might be before him?
answers: The voice sounded like Jacob’s, but the hands felt like Esau’s
Jacob immediately told him the truth
Isaac clearly saw his face
medium.explanation: Isaac heard Jacob’s voice but felt hairy hands like Esau’s.

challenge.question: What created Isaac’s greatest uncertainty about the son’s identity?
answers: The conflict between the voice and the hands
The absence of game in the house
The fact that the son wanted to eat
challenge.explanation: Isaac heard Jacob’s voice but felt Esau’s hairy hands, so his senses conflicted.

challenge.question: Why did Jacob succeed in making Isaac think he was Esau?
answers: Isaac could not hear him
His hands were hairy like Esau’s
Esau was standing beside him
challenge.explanation: Although the voice sounded like Jacob’s, the hairy hands made Isaac think he was Esau.

challenge.question: What can be inferred from Isaac blessing Jacob only after touching him?
answers: The touch strengthened his belief that this was Esau
He decided not to bless anyone
He immediately realized Jacob was lying
challenge.explanation: After feeling hands like Esau’s, Isaac accepted the disguise and blessed him.

questions.question: What created Isaac’s greatest uncertainty about the son’s identity?
answers: The conflict between the voice and the hands
The absence of game in the house
The fact that the son wanted to eat
questions.explanation: Isaac heard Jacob’s voice but felt Esau’s hairy hands, so his senses conflicted.

questions.question: Why did Jacob succeed in making Isaac think he was Esau?
answers: Isaac could not hear him
His hands were hairy like Esau’s
Esau was standing beside him
questions.explanation: Although the voice sounded like Jacob’s, the hairy hands made Isaac think he was Esau.

questions.question: What can be inferred from Isaac blessing Jacob only after touching him?
answers: The touch strengthened his belief that this was Esau
He decided not to bless anyone
He immediately realized Jacob was lying
questions.explanation: After feeling hands like Esau’s, Isaac accepted the disguise and blessed him.

paragraphs.title: The meal and the kiss before the blessing

easy.question: Who asked, “Art thou my very son Esau?”
answers: Isaac
Jacob
Esau
easy.explanation: Isaac asked whether the son was Esau.

easy.question: What did the son answer?
answers: I am Esau
I do not know
I am
easy.explanation: The son answered simply, “I am.”

easy.question: What did the son bring Isaac to drink?
answers: Water
Wine
Milk
easy.explanation: After the meal, the son brought Isaac wine, and he drank.

medium.question: Why did Isaac ask to eat his son’s venison?
answers: So he could bless him
So he could go hunting
So he could give him a drink
medium.explanation: Isaac said he wanted to eat so that his soul could bless his son.

medium.question: In “I will eat of my son’s venison,” what is “venison”?
answers: A garment
A gift
The meat of a hunted animal
medium.explanation: Venison is meat obtained from an animal that has been hunted.

medium.question: What is the order of events in these verses?
answers: Isaac drank, asked a question, and then ate
Isaac asked, ate and drank, and then requested a kiss
Isaac blessed, drank, and then asked who the son was
medium.explanation: Isaac first asked whether he was Esau, then ate and drank, and finally asked for a kiss.

challenge.question: Who is the son speaking in these verses, according to the chapter’s story?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Eliezer
challenge.explanation: The son is Jacob, who is pretending to be Esau to receive Isaac’s blessing.

challenge.question: What can be inferred from Isaac’s request, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son”?
answers: Isaac wanted the son to bring him game
Isaac wanted to come close and kiss him
Isaac wanted the son to leave the house
challenge.explanation: Isaac asks the son to come close so that he can kiss him.

challenge.question: What is the connection between eating and blessing in Isaac’s words?
answers: Eating was to prepare Isaac to bless his son
Eating was meant to prevent the blessing
Eating was punishment for the son’s delay
challenge.explanation: Isaac explicitly wanted to eat so that his soul could bless his son.

questions.question: Who is the son speaking in these verses, according to the chapter’s story?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Eliezer
questions.explanation: The son is Jacob, who is pretending to be Esau to receive Isaac’s blessing.

questions.question: What can be inferred from Isaac’s request, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son”?
answers: Isaac wanted the son to bring him game
Isaac wanted to come close and kiss him
Isaac wanted the son to leave the house
questions.explanation: Isaac asks the son to come close so that he can kiss him.

questions.question: What is the connection between eating and blessing in Isaac’s words?
answers: Eating was to prepare Isaac to bless his son
Eating was meant to prevent the blessing
Eating was punishment for the son’s delay
questions.explanation: Isaac explicitly wanted to eat so that his soul could bless his son.

paragraphs.title: Isaac gives Jacob the firstborn’s blessing

easy.question: Who blessed Jacob?
answers: Isaac
Esau
Abraham
easy.explanation: Isaac spoke the blessing over Jacob.

easy.question: What did Isaac compare the smell of Jacob’s clothes to?
answers: The smell of the house
The smell of a blessed field
The smell of game
easy.explanation: Isaac said his son’s smell was like the smell of a field blessed by the Lord.

easy.question: What had Esau done before coming to Isaac?
answers: Gone home
Blessed Jacob
Come from hunting
easy.explanation: Esau came to Isaac from his hunting.

medium.question: What abundance did Isaac ask God to give Jacob?
answers: Dew, the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine
Silver, gold, and houses
Horses, servants, and weapons
medium.explanation: Isaac asked for the dew of heaven, the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine.

medium.question: In “plenty of corn and wine,” what does “wine” refer to?
answers: Oil
Wine
Water
medium.explanation: The verse names wine together with corn as products of the land’s abundance.

medium.question: What does “be lord over thy brethren” mean?
answers: Jacob will work for his brothers
Jacob will separate from his brothers
Jacob will rule over his brothers
medium.explanation: Isaac blessed Jacob with authority over his brothers.

challenge.question: What is the order of events described in these verses?
answers: Isaac finishes blessing Jacob, Jacob leaves, and Esau enters from hunting
Esau enters, Isaac blesses Jacob, and then Jacob leaves
Jacob goes hunting, Esau is blessed, and then Isaac enters
challenge.explanation: Jacob leaves after the blessing, and Esau then arrives from hunting.

challenge.question: What does the blessing “cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee” promise?
answers: Only his family will honor him
Those who curse him will suffer, and those who bless him will be blessed
Jacob will be able to bless and curse everyone
challenge.explanation: The blessing promises special protection: those who curse Jacob will be cursed, and those who bless him will be blessed.

challenge.question: Why was the smell of the clothes important to Isaac’s blessing?
answers: Isaac thought the clothes were made of expensive wool
The smell proved Jacob had come from the city
Isaac interpreted the smell as that of a blessed field
challenge.explanation: Isaac compared the smell to that of a field blessed by the Lord and continued blessing Jacob.

questions.question: What is the order of events described in these verses?
answers: Isaac finishes blessing Jacob, Jacob leaves, and Esau enters from hunting
Esau enters, Isaac blesses Jacob, and then Jacob leaves
Jacob goes hunting, Esau is blessed, and then Isaac enters
questions.explanation: Jacob leaves after the blessing, and Esau then arrives from hunting.

questions.question: What does the blessing “cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee” promise?
answers: Only his family will honor him
Those who curse him will suffer, and those who bless him will be blessed
Jacob will be able to bless and curse everyone
questions.explanation: The blessing promises special protection: those who curse Jacob will be cursed, and those who bless him will be blessed.

questions.question: Why was the smell of the clothes important to Isaac’s blessing?
answers: Isaac thought the clothes were made of expensive wool
The smell proved Jacob had come from the city
Isaac interpreted the smell as that of a blessed field
questions.explanation: Isaac compared the smell to that of a field blessed by the Lord and continued blessing Jacob.

paragraphs.title: Esau brings the food, and Isaac trembles

easy.question: Who prepared and brought Isaac savory food?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Abraham
easy.explanation: Esau prepared food and brought it to his father Isaac.

easy.question: Why did Esau ask Isaac to eat?
answers: So Isaac would bless him
So Isaac would sleep
So Isaac would go hunting
easy.explanation: Esau asked Isaac to eat so that Isaac would bless him.

easy.question: How did Isaac react after hearing Esau?
answers: He laughed
He was silent
He trembled greatly
easy.explanation: The verse says that Isaac trembled very exceedingly.

medium.question: What did Esau do before asking Isaac to eat and bless him?
answers: He prepared food and brought it to his father
He went to bless Jacob
He asked Isaac to go hunting
medium.explanation: Esau first prepared and brought the food, and then asked Isaac to eat and bless him.

medium.question: In “he also had made savoury meat,” what does “savoury meat” mean?
answers: Special clothing
Tasty food
Hunting equipment
medium.explanation: It means tasty food prepared for Isaac to eat.

medium.question: Why was Isaac frightened when Esau arrived?
answers: Esau had brought nothing
Isaac discovered Esau was not the firstborn
Someone else had already brought him game, and Isaac had eaten and blessed him
medium.explanation: Isaac said that someone had already brought him game, which he had eaten before blessing that person.

challenge.question: What can be understood from the word “also” in “he also had made savoury meat”?
answers: Esau prepared food in addition to someone else
Esau did not prepare any food
Esau prepared the same food twice
challenge.explanation: “Also” suggests that Esau prepared food in addition to the food already brought by someone else.

challenge.question: What does Isaac’s statement, “yea, and he shall be blessed,” show about his position?
answers: Isaac decided not to bless anyone
Isaac declared that the person he had blessed would remain blessed
Isaac realized that Esau had blessed him
challenge.explanation: Despite his shock, Isaac declared that the person already blessed would remain blessed.

challenge.question: Which detail shows that the person who received the blessing came before Esau?
answers: Isaac asked Esau who he was
Esau said he was the firstborn
Isaac said he had already eaten before Esau came
challenge.explanation: Isaac had eaten the game before Esau arrived, so someone else had come first and received the blessing.

questions.question: What can be understood from the word “also” in “he also had made savoury meat”?
answers: Esau prepared food in addition to someone else
Esau did not prepare any food
Esau prepared the same food twice
questions.explanation: “Also” suggests that Esau prepared food in addition to the food already brought by someone else.

questions.question: What does Isaac’s statement, “yea, and he shall be blessed,” show about his position?
answers: Isaac decided not to bless anyone
Isaac declared that the person he had blessed would remain blessed
Isaac realized that Esau had blessed him
questions.explanation: Despite his shock, Isaac declared that the person already blessed would remain blessed.

questions.question: Which detail shows that the person who received the blessing came before Esau?
answers: Isaac asked Esau who he was
Esau said he was the firstborn
Isaac said he had already eaten before Esau came
questions.explanation: Isaac had eaten the game before Esau arrived, so someone else had come first and received the blessing.

paragraphs.title: Esau cries out and discovers the deception

easy.question: What did Esau do when he heard his father’s words?
answers: He cried out bitterly and asked for a blessing
He quietly left the house
He blessed Jacob
easy.explanation: Esau cried out bitterly and asked his father to bless him too.

easy.question: Who, according to Isaac, had taken the blessing?
answers: Esau
Jacob
Laban
easy.explanation: Isaac said, “Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.”

easy.question: What did Esau ask his father at the end?
answers: To give him the birthright
To drive Jacob away
Whether Isaac had reserved a blessing for him
easy.explanation: Esau asked whether his father had kept a blessing for him.

medium.question: Why did Esau cry out and weep bitterly?
answers: Jacob had left the house
He realized that the blessing had been given to Jacob
Isaac did not recognize him
medium.explanation: Esau learned that Isaac had already blessed Jacob and was deeply distressed.

medium.question: What sequence of events does Esau mention?
answers: Jacob took the blessing and then the birthright
Isaac blessed Esau and then Jacob
Jacob took the birthright and then the blessing
medium.explanation: Esau says Jacob first took his birthright and now has taken his blessing.

medium.question: In “Thy brother came with subtilty,” what does “subtilty” mean?
answers: Cunning or deception
Great speed
Intense anger
medium.explanation: The word means cunning or trickery; Isaac viewed Jacob’s approach as deceptive.

challenge.question: Why does Esau connect Jacob’s name with his actions?
answers: Because Jacob was the younger son
Because Jacob loved the field
Because Esau says Jacob supplanted him twice
challenge.explanation: Esau plays on Jacob’s name and says Jacob deceived him twice—over the birthright and the blessing.

challenge.question: What can be understood from “Bless me, even me also, O my father”?
answers: Esau asks for his own blessing even though the main blessing was already given
Esau gives up every blessing
Esau asks that Jacob’s birthright be returned
challenge.explanation: The word “also” shows that Esau wants his father to bless him too.

challenge.question: What does Esau add by mentioning both the birthright and the blessing?
answers: He never wanted to be firstborn
He views the loss of both as a series of wrongs against him
The birthright and blessing are exactly the same thing
challenge.explanation: Esau presents the loss of the birthright and the blessing as two connected injuries.

questions.question: Why does Esau connect Jacob’s name with his actions?
answers: Because Jacob was the younger son
Because Jacob loved the field
Because Esau says Jacob supplanted him twice
questions.explanation: Esau plays on Jacob’s name and says Jacob deceived him twice—over the birthright and the blessing.

questions.question: What can be understood from “Bless me, even me also, O my father”?
answers: Esau asks for his own blessing even though the main blessing was already given
Esau gives up every blessing
Esau asks that Jacob’s birthright be returned
questions.explanation: The word “also” shows that Esau wants his father to bless him too.

questions.question: What does Esau add by mentioning both the birthright and the blessing?
answers: He never wanted to be firstborn
He views the loss of both as a series of wrongs against him
The birthright and blessing are exactly the same thing
questions.explanation: Esau presents the loss of the birthright and the blessing as two connected injuries.

paragraphs.title: Isaac gives Esau the remaining blessing

easy.question: Whom did Isaac make lord over his brothers?
answers: Jacob
Esau
Laban
easy.explanation: Isaac said that he had made Jacob lord over his brothers.

easy.question: What did Esau do after asking for a blessing?
answers: He went to war
He wept
He went on his way
easy.explanation: The verse says that Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

easy.question: By what did Isaac say Esau would live?
answers: By manna
By water
By his sword
easy.explanation: Isaac said, “By thy sword shalt thou live.”

medium.question: Why did Isaac say he had no similar blessing left for Esau?
answers: He had already given Jacob authority, servants, and the chief abundance
Isaac did not want to speak with Esau
Esau had already received all the land
medium.explanation: Isaac explained that he had already given Jacob dominion, servants, corn, and wine.

medium.question: What did Esau ask his father after hearing Isaac’s words?
answers: That his brother serve him
That Isaac bless him too
That Isaac give him all his possessions
medium.explanation: Esau asked his father for a blessing as well.

medium.question: In “when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke,” what is the situation described?
answers: When Esau is distressed and rebels
When Esau eats and drinks
When Esau sleeps at home
medium.explanation: The verse describes Esau eventually breaking free from Jacob’s rule.

challenge.question: What change in the relationship between Esau and Jacob is described?
answers: Esau will always rule Jacob
Esau will serve Jacob, but will eventually break his yoke
Both will serve their father
challenge.explanation: Isaac describes Esau serving Jacob but later becoming free from his rule.

challenge.question: What can be understood from combining “the fatness of the earth” with “by thy sword shalt thou live”?
answers: Esau will have good living conditions but also a life connected with conflict
Esau will live only in a foodless wilderness
Esau will have complete peace without hardship
challenge.explanation: The blessing includes both agricultural abundance and a life involving struggle.

challenge.question: Which detail shows that Esau thought Isaac had only one blessing left?
answers: He asked, “Hast thou but one blessing, my father?”
He asked to go hunting
He said Jacob was not his brother
challenge.explanation: Esau’s question suggests that he believed another blessing might remain for him.

questions.question: What change in the relationship between Esau and Jacob is described?
answers: Esau will always rule Jacob
Esau will serve Jacob, but will eventually break his yoke
Both will serve their father
questions.explanation: Isaac describes Esau serving Jacob but later becoming free from his rule.

questions.question: What can be understood from combining “the fatness of the earth” with “by thy sword shalt thou live”?
answers: Esau will have good living conditions but also a life connected with conflict
Esau will live only in a foodless wilderness
Esau will have complete peace without hardship
questions.explanation: The blessing includes both agricultural abundance and a life involving struggle.

questions.question: Which detail shows that Esau thought Isaac had only one blessing left?
answers: He asked, “Hast thou but one blessing, my father?”
He asked to go hunting
He said Jacob was not his brother
questions.explanation: Esau’s question suggests that he believed another blessing might remain for him.

paragraphs.title: Esau bears a grudge, and Rebekah warns Jacob

easy.question: Why did Esau hate Jacob?
answers: Because of the blessing Isaac gave Jacob
Because Jacob took his flock
Because Jacob left home
